mapper.sql: id, evaluation_task_id, tenant_id, model_version_id, benchmark_id, overall_scores::text AS overall_scores, category_scores::text AS category_scores, sample_count, detail_path, completed_at, created_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO evaluation_result (evaluation_task_id, tenant_id, model_version_id, benchmark_id, overall_scores, category_scores, sample_count, detail_path, completed_at) VALUES (#{evaluationTaskId}, #{tenantId}, #{modelVersionId}, #{benchmarkId}, CAST(#{overallScores} AS JSONB), CAST(#{categoryScores} AS JSONB), #{sampleCount}, #{detailPath}, COALESCE(#{completedAt}, NOW()))
mapper.select: SELECT FROM evaluation_result WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM evaluation_result WHERE evaluation_task_id = #{taskId} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId}
